# Éclat Institute — 100% Online Global Academy
> Official URL: https://eclat.institute
> Institution Type: Accredited 100% Online International Institute
> Focus Disciplines: Technology, Software Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity & World Languages
> Target Audience: Local & International Students & Working Professionals Worldwide

## Institutional Overview
Éclat Institute is an accredited 100% online global academy offering live virtual interactive classes, on-demand video learning, and verified international credentials.

## Academic Departments & Programs
1. Department of Software Engineering & Computer Science:
   - Full-Stack Web Development & Modern JavaScript (React 19 & Node.js)
   - Python Programming, SQL & Data Analytics
   - Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking Masterclass
2. Department of Digital Skills & Business Technology:
   - Comprehensive Computer Packages & Digital Literacy
   - QuickBooks & Corporate Accounting
3. Department of Languages & Global Communication:
   - IELTS Academic & General Training Exam Coaching (Band 7.5 - 9.0)
   - German Language (Goethe-Zertifikat A1-B2)
   - French Language (DELF/DALF Preparation)
   - Modern Standard Arabic Fluency
   - Kiswahili Language Diploma

## Virtual Learning Features
- 100% Virtual Google Meet & Zoom Classrooms with Morning, Afternoon, Evening, and Night shift options.
- 24/7 Cloud Learning Management System (LMS) with instant video playback, progress auto-tracking, and downloadable module notes.
- Globally verifiable digital certificates with unique security verification codes.
- Flexible USD tuition billing with 2-part installment payment plans.
